rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact mass across the views, with the same dominant prismatic body and a consistent top cut, so it avoids the “one-view-only” failure. The parcel relationship appears generally contained and the primary gesture is legible. Program-fit is acceptable for neighborhood living because the form can plausibly host a compact mixed-use/street building, but it is only moderately aligned with the brief: the mass is still mostly a sealed rectangular extrusion with a small top notch and limited evidence of an active public ground threshold. The blue frontage edge is acknowledged only weakly; there is no strong court, carve, or entry seam that clearly opens to that access edge. The silhouette is coherent and not merely arbitrary stepping, but the roof/section logic remains calm rather than program-productive. Overall: passable early-stage massing, but it needs a more explicit carved public void or access-side threshold to better support the neighborhood brief.
